title: Qwen3.8-27B AtomicChat AD-Q4_K on RTX 4090 — KV-quant context ladder to 260k
slug_note: The 15.9GB AD layout frees ~800MB vs unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL, pushing 24GB-card context ceilings to 110k (FP16 KV) / 190k (Q8 KV) / 260k (Q4 KV) at a flat ~42 tok/s.

variation.quant_detail: AD-Q4_K — Atomic Dynamic layer allocation; 15.9GB vs unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL 16.7GB; publisher's own imatrix on BF16, perplexity re-measured vs original weights

engine.config: Full GPU offload (-ngl 99), zero system RAM offload. KV-cache quantization sets the context ceiling: default FP16 (110k), -ctv/-ctk q8_0 (190k), q4_0 (260k).

requirements.notes: 23.50GB VRAM at the 110k FP16 ceiling, 23.72GB at 190k Q8, 22.35GB at 260k Q4 — everything stays on-card. VRAM-bound: full GPU offload, zero system RAM offload — 24GB shown as a practical host floor; the ceiling is the card's 24GB (see notes).

steps.text: llama-server -m Qwen3.8-27B-AD-Q4_K.gguf -c {110000|190000|260000} -ngl 99 --port 8080 [-ctv q8_0 -ctk q8_0 | -ctv q4_0 -ctk q4_0]

measurements.note: @190k ctx ceiling, Q8 KV (-ctv/-ctk q8_0), 23.72GB VRAM
@260k ctx, Q4 KV, 22.35GB VRAM ('perfectly flat and stable'; headroom to maybe 300k)
VRAM at the 190k Q8-KV ceiling (23.50 FP16@110k; 22.35 Q4@260k)

caveats: Decode is flat (41.9-42.2 tok/s) across the whole KV ladder — the ceiling moves, the speed doesn't.
At 22.35GB for 260k Q4 KV the author believes 300k native is reachable on 24GB (untested).
Comparison ceilings vs unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL on the same card: FP16 KV 100k->110k, Q8 170k->190k.
AtomicChat is a first-time publisher for this directory; the quant card documents an own-imatrix, held-out perplexity method and publishes imatrix.gguf.
KL-divergence comparison charts live as images in the post replies — not extracted.
